reviews.comment: The class I took seemed very easy at first. However, he graded the first assignment very late which I got a 10/100. When I checked my grade, I had only 1 day to drop the class with a partial refund and it was inconvenient for me to seek guidance from the advisor on time to make the decision without making a bad decision.
Professor provided great lectures that explained the textbook material well enough. Not overly difficult. I like the way the homework built up to the final 2 assignments.

Mandatory attendance, lectures were decently explained, homeworks are on the easy side, exams were somewhat hard but you should be fine as long as you were comfortable with the practice exam and understand the lecture content. Overall teaches you about the basics of AI algo well.
The course gives a good introduction to AI basics. Slide deck is sufficient and exhaustive. Professor is considerate and cares for students.

Lecture videos can be played at 1.5x speed, transcript available if you don't want to watch a video. Easy to understand. Covers all material on exams and hw. Sometimes boring tho. If you understand the material, exams and hw are easy and don't take long. Cheat sheet on exam. Prof is friendly enough, no problems.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Other reviews said he has a big ego or is threatening, but I don't see that at all. He was very kind and was very relaxed in terms of grading. Overall the class was pretty fun, but I didn't like the mandatory attendance policy, and the organization of assignments on Canvas was done poorly. Several contradictions or missing info in rubrics.
Very chill. Mandatory in-person attendance

Okay this is an easy class if you are good at taking tests. His assignments are easy. But you still have to get really good marks in all your assignments and the two exams to get an A. The only gripe I have is, is that the classes are boring. But the material is easy to study before the exam.
The Prof. does not curve and there is no extra credit.

This professor uses threatening language in emails, announcements, and assignment instructions, making students feel anxious rather than supported. His lectures are unclear, and his communication is poor. The class environment should be focused on learning, not on intimidation and unnecessary stress.

This professor is unapproachable and focused on his ego. His lectures are difficult to follow, and his communication is poor. He holds students to an unreasonable standard but doesn't follow the same expectations himself. The focus of any class should be teaching and learning, not catering to one person's ego. Disappointing from TAMU.
Very straightforward class and professor. He provides practice exams and allows you to bring a 'cheat sheet' which makes studying for the real exams easy and time efficient.

Dr. C's class was a challenging experience. He treats students like children, with a strict, unapproachable demeanor and 1 line negative responses to emails. His lectures are confusing pushing students to rely on textbooks. Exams are based on his chaotic slides & lectures. If possible, avoid taking his class—there's no support or empathy here.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He grades only on a few things. If you mess up any assignment, you can forget your A. Exams are similar to practice tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Choe is a nice guy. Lecture slides are dreadful and I found it impossible to pay attention for 1 hour 15 minutes in his lectures. Homework is graded hard but exams are very fair. Practice exams are similar to the real exams, but he doesn't give solutions to practice exams. Half the class is ML, other half is boring prop. logic + other stuff.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a demanding professor, but teaching this subject requires you to be one. Outside of the class, he is actually approachable and cares about what he teaches. Lectures might get a little hefty but then again there's so much math in ML that it just becomes lengthy. He really needs to work on the course structure a little bit.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 4 HWs, 2 Exams, 5% attendance. 1 printer paper 2 sided cheat sheet allowed for exams and the exam review helps a lot. Grading is pretty fair for both exams and HW, but sometimes the slides are unclear when trying to complete HW problems. Overall, this class is more theory than computation. Great prof but boring lectures. The ML part was more fun.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: DO NOT try to do homework by yourself! Find all the answers online, or you will NEVER get an A! I know where to find the answer, but I didn't use them. That's how I get a B. The mean scores of the last two assignments even reached 99 and 98. How can it be possible? Does he really think he is so good that every student can get 100 on homework? :)

Worst professor ever met. 
Ask students to pin and screenshot their homework after every problem. Homework is based on Colab, which sometimes has problems in pinning the version. 
Lecture notes are disasters. Always abbreviations show up without any explanation. Have to go through the slides beneath. 
Not care about students or teaching. 
RUN!!

Had him for CSCE 420 as well, his lectures for AI and ML are very well structured and if you study the past exams you will be ok. The homeworks take a little bit so you should start early and he is very generous with late work (only 1 point taken off for every hour late).
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Choe is amazing! Definitely recommend him. He's genuine and very nice - great at answering questions! Take good notes and pay attention in lectures. Study the past exam he provides, the slides, and your notes you and will do great on the exams. He doesn't make exams unnecessarily difficult, but you need to understand the material.
He is very dedicated and helpful and will make sure that you understand the coursework.
He is a cool guy who has excellent command over the subject.
Teaches at a graduate class level
